_README: BASELINE OF SERIOUS/CRITICAL AXE-CORE VIOLATIONS THAT EXISTED WHEN THE GATE WAS ADDED (2026-11-22).
This is a RATCHET, not an allowlist. Read by the 'Accessibility (axe-core, sampled pages)' test in
Shape: debt[<page url>] = [<axe rule id>, ...]. Keyed by page and rule id, never by element count,
so adding a review card or a blog card does not move it.
The test fails in both directions: a serious or critical rule id on a sampled page that is not
listed here fails, and an entry here that the page no longer violates fails too. So an entry can
only leave this file, in the same PR that fixes the markup. Do not add an entry to make a new
failure go away: fix the markup.
Recorded by running the test in Chromium at 1440x900 and 375x812 on 8 sampled pages. Seven were
clean and the eighth held one entry (/pages/blog.html, label-content-name-mismatch on the
#blog-load-more button). That entry was fixed and removed on 2026-11-23 (P6-67): the button no
longer has an aria-label, so its accessible name is its visible text. The baseline has been empty
since then, and any new serious or critical violation on a sampled page fails the test.
